Subject: AugmentIQ renewal proposal + updated pricing (SOW v2 attached)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our discussion I’m attaching an updated SOW (AugmentIQ_SOW_v2.pdf) and a pricing worksheet (AugmentIQ_pricing_0326.xlsx). High level: your current enrichment feed (standard entity enrichment + email match) is up for renewal on 2026-04-15.

Options we’re proposing:
- 12 months: current rates + 15% discount if signed by 2026-04-10
- 24 months: 25% discount + free migration assistance (one week of engineering support)

We also included a usage break-down and a new per-100k-records price for high-volume customers (see spreadsheet). We’ve added a deduplication add-on (beta) that we think will reduce tokens and effective unit cost for you — happy to put you on a short pilot.

Can you confirm who will be the signer and whether we should route the contract through your procurement or through legal? If useful I can open a DocuSign and share.

—Samir

Marissa / Samir — quick technical notes from our side:
- Current feed volume: ~2.4M enrichment calls/month (peaks to 3M) with ~60% email-match workloads.
- The dedupe beta sounds promising — if it reduces effective calls by ~25% we could materially lower spend. We’d want a short trial (2 weeks) scoped against our test bucket.
- Are there per-request payload size limits for the dedupe add-on? Also: does the new per-100k price in the spreadsheet assume dedupe is applied?

Also, we’ve had occasional tokenization mismatches on a small subset of records (attached a snippet in the Drive). If AugmentIQ can commit to a small SLA on match-rate accuracy for production feeds, that would help justify a multi-year commitment.

—Karthik
Principal Data Engineer, Redwood Inference

Folks — finance notes:
- We have a constrained Q2 vendor budget. For a renewal to proceed in Q2 we’ll need to see the absolute net-new spend (what we’ll pay this year vs current committed) broken out by month. Please add a column in the pricing worksheet that shows raw monthly cash out (post-discount).
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net 45, but for renewals we can accept Net 60 only with Finance sign-off. If AugmentIQ requires Net 30 that’s going to be a hard ask.
- Compliance: we need a current SOC 2 Type II report and a clear data retention + deletion clause (we prefer 90 days post-contract for customer-identifiable enrichment data).

I can review SOW redlines once we have the agreed price table. If AugmentIQ can commit to an accuracy SLA for the email-match this would also be helpful when presenting to Procurement.

—Laura
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Marissa / team — thanks for the detailed feedback and the helpful questions. Quick counter-proposal based on what you asked: 
- 12-month: 15% off list, with a 2-week dedupe pilot included at no charge.
- 24-month: 25% off list, free migration assistance (one week engineering) as noted.
- Payment terms: we can accept Net 60 for enterprise renewals (Finance sign-off on our side required).
- Compliance: attaching our latest SOC2 Type II report (SOC2_AugmentIQ_2025.pdf). We’re fine adding a 90-day post-contract deletion clause into the SOW.

We’ll also add the raw monthly cash flow columns you requested into the pricing worksheet and re-upload by EOD tomorrow. I’ve opened a DocuSign with a provisional signature block for Redwood’s CFO to review: https://www.docusign.com/augmentiq/RENEWAL-2026.

If you can confirm the signer and whether you prefer the 12 or 24 month term I’ll push the updated SOW/DocuSign for signature.
